messages.subject: Boxplot
parts:
Hello,

I would like to adapt my script to produce the graphic below.

Thanks in advance for your attention!

p <- ggplot (df, aes (type, lmean, fill = type)) + geom_boxplot () + scale_fill_viridis (discrete = TRUE, alpha = .6) + geom_jitter (color = 'black', size = 1, alpha = .9) + theme_ipsum () + theme (legend.position = 'none', plot.title = element_text (size = 11)) + ggtitle ('A boxplot with jitter') + xlab (' ')
